about_the_game:
To Our English-Speaking Players.

The English demo of TOGATSUNAGI was initially created using text generated by ChatGPT, and the final version was reviewed by a human editor. However, after having it rechecked by a native English speaker, I was informed that the translation contained a number of inaccuracies.

As a result, I am currently commissioning a complete retranslation of the English version from scratch by a professional translator.

I sincerely apologize for the repeated inconvenience this situation has caused.

If possible, I hope to re-release the updated English version later this month or next month.

About This Game

This is a story-driven 2D action fantasy game in which you switch between a swordswoman and a gunslinger protagonist to battle the Mamono (monsters) that threaten your path.

The game places strong emphasis on character illustrations and features a cast of distinctive and memorable characters.

The story is planned to unfold over a total of four chapters. The currently available version is Chapter 1.

The final version is planned to feature multiple endings. The game will remain free even after completion.

This game was developed using RPG Maker MZ. The total playtime has not yet been determined.

Please note that the game contains grotesque content. Player discretion is advised.

Story

The righteous nation of Hyuiria (pronounced: Hyoo-I-ria), home to people who worship the goddess of justice Hyustiria (pronounced: Hyoo-STI-ria), had long protected its citizens from the Mamono by using the magic-imbued device known as the Magic Conduit. This device projected a barrier across the entire country and kept the Mamono at bay.

 

However, one day, an unknown party forced the Conduit to shut down. The barrier vanished, allowing the Mamono to enter the nation freely.

 

Amid the chaos, Rinka, who had traveled to this foreign land in search of her younger brother, reunited with her childhood friend Ryu, who happened to be visiting the country as well. Before they could fully understand what was happening, they were caught in a sudden Mamono attack and lost consciousness.

 

When they awoke in an unfamiliar place, the one standing before them was their former friend Alto.

 

They soon learned that the entire incident had been orchestrated by him—and that he had bound their lives together with a mysterious power. Because of this, they began to share each other’s wounds, pain, and even their very lives.

 

The only way to reactivate the Conduit and break the bond placed upon them was to kill Alto.

 

Though torn by the thought of killing a former friend, Rinka and Ryu pursue him to save the nation and free themselves from the power placed upon them. As their journey unfolds, they gradually begin to witness the true nature of the so-called “nation of justice.”

Live Streaming and Prohibited Actions

■ Redistribution of the Game

 

Redistribution of the game is strictly prohibited.

 

Unauthorized reproduction, redistribution, or reuploading of any in-game images, music, or assets is also prohibited.

 

All borrowed materials remain the copyright of their respective creators.

 

The developer assumes no responsibility for any damages or issues arising from the use of this work.

 

Thank you for your understanding.

 

■ Live Streaming and Let’s Plays

You may stream or create gameplay videos without prior permission.

 

As long as you follow the guidelines below, you are free to share your content.

 

If any violations are found, we may request the removal of the content.

Prohibited Actions for Live Streaming

■ Streaming or Broadcasting Clear Bonus Content

The clear bonus content is intended as a special reward for players who complete the game. Streaming, recording, or broadcasting this content is strictly prohibited.

 

Accessing or viewing the clear bonus content during a live stream is also prohibited, even if the screen is hidden or obscured.

 

Posting any images, text, or other materials from the clear bonus content on social media is strictly prohibited.

 

■ Streaming While Defaming or Harassing the Work

Streaming content that includes defamatory, abusive, or excessively disrespectful remarks about the game is prohibited, regardless of intent.

 

■ Spoilers in Video Titles

You may use in-game still images as thumbnails; however, please avoid images that contain major spoilers.

 

▼ Please include the game title in your video titles.

 

■ Creative Works

Fan creations are welcome. However, please refrain from creating works that violate the law or public order.

 

■ Critical Opinions

Constructive criticism is welcome. However, excessively abusive or inappropriate comments may be subject to removal.

 

■ Credits

Credits are listed within the game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains gore, murder, and other grotesque depictions. It also contains discriminatory depictions of imaginary creatures and races.
